answer: Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The ridge panel is drawn blind, the terrace escrow settles at close, and relic lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 25% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 116 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
